content: Fiye 20:1-18 Abalaham eŋ Abimelek adi’walaŋ mede
Kaŋ Abalaham adi Mamele’walaŋ bem muŋgohom fiye wabiŋa Negeb kwetneŋ Kades eŋ Sulu lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ Gela yokwet ikukneŋ uŋaŋ hogok buŋambu hatiguk.
Tiŋa tamŋiŋ Salahdok “witne” yoguk. Kaŋ Gela niŋ mapme Abimelekdi tipilapilaye meŋiŋ niŋ niŋkulune wooŋ Salah nagila adi’walaŋ yolineŋ uguk.
Unduŋ tubune Bepaŋdi domo ginaŋ Abimelek mintamiŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Du tam u nagilaŋaŋ doktiŋa kumuŋdok gigit tilaŋ. Maŋgoŋde tam woŋ adi me niŋ’walaŋ.”
Abimelek adi tam wondut nemu hatiguk doktiŋa indiŋ yoguk, “Wapum, du mebop didimehi indi nihitubukadakawene be yolaŋ?
Abalaham adi indiŋ naniŋguk, ‘Adi witne’ eŋ tamdi maaŋ yoŋak, ‘Adi witne’. Doktiŋa nu nemek tiŋat wooŋ adi agaŋ walane walaniŋ tiŋat. Eŋ kohone maaŋ walaniŋ.”
Kaŋ Bepaŋdi domo ginaŋ indiŋ niŋguk, “Du nemek u walage walaniŋ halune tiŋaŋ u nu maaŋ nadilat. Ala woŋ adi nugoŋ honewaaŋneŋ yoŋa kamehegamuŋat kaŋ mu kadakaŋaŋ.

Ale indidegoŋ du me u tamuŋiŋ tubuudanemimbeŋ, adi polofet hatilak doktiŋa adi dutok tiŋa ninadi kwanai tibek. Eŋ, du tam u mu tubuudanemimbeŋ adi biyagoŋ hinek da eŋ magemageye hidi adi kumuŋdapmaŋ tineeŋ.”
Kaŋ Abimelek adi haniŋ hinek pilali kwanai kadoko meŋiye yehibopneeŋ mede u hogohogok yenindapmaune kisaŋ muntagiŋ.

Unduŋ tiŋa Abimelekdi Abalaham nihamaneŋ indiŋ ninadiguk, “Du maŋgoŋ tinamguŋ? Nu maŋgoŋ kadakaniŋ tigamugut doktiŋa nu eŋ manemaneye indi foloŋ folofigita kamenimiŋaŋ? Du nutok nemek mu titiŋ hinek tinamuguŋ.”
Tiŋa tomboyoula Abalaham indiŋ ninadiguk, “Du dediŋ nadiŋa unduŋ tinamguŋ?”
Kaŋ Abalahamdibo niŋguk, “Nu indiŋ nadisuŋa nemek u tugut. Me kwet iŋahi adi Bepaŋ gikiŋgoŋ mu timiiŋ. Doktiŋa nu tamne doktiŋa nulukumuneeneŋ.
Tiŋa undigoŋ adi adi biyagoŋku witne, batne’walaŋ wabiŋiŋ. Mane’walaŋ wabiŋiŋ mooŋ. Iŋgoŋ oŋ, adi agaŋ tamne tuguk.
Ala Bepaŋdi nanimbune batne yoli bikabuŋa kwet gitipmuŋ ginaŋ bugut nai uŋaniŋ nu indiŋ niŋgut, ‘Yokwet uŋoŋ be uŋoŋ usuwaaŋ nu nabukahileeŋ indiŋ yoluwaaŋ adi adi witne.’”
Unduŋ yobune Abimelekdi dompa makau eŋ tipilapilaye metam yanagila wooŋ Abalahamdok boimiŋguk. Tiŋa yeguk e tamuŋiŋ Salah maaŋ tubuudanemiŋguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa Abalaham indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadilaŋ be, kwatne namandake foloŋ yuku hali ulak. Ala da uŋoŋ be uŋoŋ hatibene nadiŋa kedem hatiluwaaŋ.”

Tiŋa Salah maaŋ indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadilaŋ be, magemageyedi nadigambune fowaakneŋ eŋ adi’walaŋ namandahik ginaŋ meekaŋgoŋ hatibaaneŋ yoŋa nu wife siliwa faki wan tausen milat. Kaŋ metamdi nadigambune du yomgenit mokit tilaŋ.”

Bepaŋ adi Abalaham tamuŋŋiŋ Salah doktiŋa Abimelek’walaŋ yolineŋ tamwoi hatigiŋ hogohogok meeniŋ ulihaka talik kameheyembune kafi tubudapmagiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa Abalaham adi Bepaŋ ninadiune Bepaŋdi Abimelek eŋ tamŋiŋ tiŋa adi’walaŋ tipilapilaye tam heki yalakihiye mintadok talik kotigoŋ dilitomyemguk.
